description: A radar behind the Start page, after a plan-position display (#608): the whole page area is its face, and a phosphor sweep turns clockwise across it from a centre behind the Omnibar, over faint range rings and spokes, its afterglow trailing behind the beam, with a blip for each open tab in the Space on show. The browser draws it (src/ui/Radar.qml); the website does not. Lengths are CSS pixels unless named otherwise; times are in seconds; a bearing is in degrees clockwise from straight up. A tab's site is its host, or for a page with no host its scheme; a blank page has none. A colour is a role (ground, light, glow, face, black, white) or a mix of two at an amount. `pitch` is 2, as the vector terrain's, so a line is thin, and `crt` is the road's glass at the road's size on screen: its pixel counts are doubled. `rest` is where the Omnibar rests, as a share of the height, and the sweep's centre stands there, in the middle of the page area's width. `night.face` mixes the night toward the glow for the face. `field` is the resting Omnibar's field and hint row, which the blips keep clear: its top edge `above` above where it rests, its bottom `omnibarReach` below at the theme's type size, which the browser hands in, `widest` wide at most and `margin` in from either side. `grid`: the face is `face`, with a range ring every `ringEvery` out from the centre and a spoke every `spokeEvery` degrees, both out past the page area's edges, in `colour` at `alpha` and `spokeAlpha`. `lines` are `width` of the Scene's pixels wide with a glow `blur` of its pixels around them at `alpha` of their colour; in a Private window the lines are the light mixed toward the ground by `unlit`, with no glow. `sweep`: a turn takes `turn` seconds at rest, and the swept area glows for `afterglow` seconds behind the beam, fading by the power `fade`, the face mixed `alpha` of the way toward `colour` at its brightest, in `slices` slices; the beam itself is `beam` alpha. From a commit until the page paints the sweep turns `spin` times as fast, its speed easing toward that at `ease` and back after the page has painted, over a frame of at most `longestStep`. A still or Private sweep stands at bearing `still`. `blips`: an open tab's blip stands at a bearing a scatter of its site gives, `range` [from, to] of the way out along it from `clear` beyond the field to `margin` in from the page area's edge, a triangle pointing up, `size` of the Scene's pixels across, with a glow `halo` times as wide at `haloAlpha` while the lights are on; the sweep lights it and it fades with the afterglow to `floor`. A picture with no Space behind it, such as a thumbnail, shows `sample` blips. A still radar's blips are all lit. On a commit, the page being opened has a blip of its own that brightens over `arrive.rise` seconds until the page paints, when its tab's own blip takes its place, with a glow `arrive.halo` times its size at `arrive.haloAlpha`. `light` is the sweep's light on the Omnibar's rim, centred where the beam leaves the field: an ellipse `across` of the rim's width and `reach` down, its stops a position, a colour and its alpha, and a bloom over it; a Private window's radar casts none.
name: Radar
